narr: Scattered thunderstorms moved developed and moved west across southeast Arizona. Storms produced heavy rain from late morning into early afternoon causing flash flooding in parts of Santa Cruz, western Cochise, and southeast Pima counties.
ev: Two inches of rain in less than 1 hour caused extensive flooding of Arivaca Road between mile markers 10 and 16 with additional flash flooding farther north near Keystone Peak.
More than 3 inches of rain in 90 minutes in Rio Rico Southwest caused flash flooding more than 1 foot deep across several roadways.
More than one inch of rain in less than 1 hour in upper reaches of Huachuca Canyon flooded the canyon and flowed across Burt Rd at Fort Huachuca.
